title: SWF: ExportAssets (tag 56) for symbol linkage
description: Verify and fix ExportAssets (tag 56) emission in packages/swf/src/compile.ts. Tag 56 maps character IDs to export names for ActionScript attachment (attachMovie, new ClassName). Format: UI16 count, then per-symbol: UI16 CharId, null-terminated string Name. Check that symbols with linkage.exportForActionScript=true and non-empty linkageIdentifier are included. ExportAssets should be emitted once per scene (in the first frame), before DoInitAction. Add 5 tests in __tests__/exportassets.test.ts.
